scope: Posthoc descriptive analysis only. No training, model loading, hyperparameter selection, or generation feedback.

formulas.accuracy_difference_pp: 100 * (accuracy_paired - accuracy_control), matched by model seed and pool size
formulas.dispersion: statistics.stdev over registered model-seed values; descriptive sample SD, not confidence interval
formulas.format_reference: log(2)/3: ideal space/EOS prediction plus a uniform A/B letter, averaged over three QA tokens

limitations: Model seeds share one generated dataset and the same questions in each evaluation split; summed evaluations are not independent theorem samples.
QA NLL averages the predictable space and EOS together with the answer letter; low QA NLL alone is not reasoning accuracy.
The proof encoder reconstructs bytes and is lossy; noncollapse and improved geometry do not certify retention or use of mathematically sufficient information.
Canonical proof input omits query-specific option order and surface atom-name mapping present in the solution-state target; whole-state regression can penalize unavailable nuisance information.
This is a fixed recipient-update budget study with nested pools, not a test of jointly unlimited data and compute or a broad refutation of mathematical transfer.
